sections.heading: Jemima Goldsmith — Early Life, Family and Education

Public records name her father, James Goldsmith and her mother, Annabel Goldsmith. She is a sibling of Zac Goldsmith, Ben Goldsmith, Rupert Birley, Robin Birley, India Jane Birley and Isabel Goldsmith.
Her listed education includes University of Bristol, SOAS, University of London, Francis Holland School and Manor Hall, Bristol.
